label: Static objective reward gap
interpretation: Authenticity minus masking in expected static reward, affine and strictly increasing in p with slope b + r.

label: Static M0 objective boundary
interpretation: The static objective acceptance crossover under the frozen M0/M1 reward parameters. This is the static M0 objective boundary and is not the M2 dynamic threshold.

label: Expected reward is affine in disclosure
interpretation: Expected reward is affine in the disclosure level d, so the derivative in d is constant and no interior level can strictly dominate both endpoints.

label: Endpoint optimum
closed_form: argmax_d E[R(d)] in {d_min, d_max} unless Delta_0(p) = 0
interpretation: The strict static optimum lies at an endpoint except at exact indifference, for any number of disclosure levels. Intermediate disclosure is therefore never objectively superior in the static problem, and E02's graded effects are learning and action-representation effects.

label: Neutral dynamic-gap decomposition
closed_form: D_N(V) = Delta_0(p) + gamma[p V_A + (1 - p) V_S - V_N]
interpretation: The Neutral-state Q gap splits into the M0 static gap plus the discounted value of entering Accepted or Stigmatized rather than remaining Neutral, so dynamic M2 can reverse the static ordering in either direction.

label: Full-information dynamic optimum
closed_form: V(s) = max_a { r(s, a) + gamma * sum_s' P(s'|s, a) V(s') }
interpretation: The E03 comparator is the exact full-information discounted optimum obtained by value iteration, independently reproduced by deterministic stationary-policy enumeration over all 357 frozen cells. It knows the complete payoff structure and is not information-matched to the learner.

label: Full-information optimum is K-invariant (one good context)
closed_form: max{R_M, R_G, R_B} independent of K
interpretation: With one fixed good context, increasing K changes only the multiplicity of R_M and R_B, never the distinct reward set, so the value attainable by a fully informed agent does not change with K. Any decline in settling is a learner and representation effect, not a change in what is objectively achievable.

label: Objective comparison-cost crossover
interpretation: The exact M3 good-context objective comparison-cost crossover under the frozen defaults R_M = 0.75 and R_G(bf) = 1.15 - 0.85 bf. It is an environmental boundary, not a learned threshold.

label: Good-versus-bad context crossover
interpretation: Bad-context authenticity is not the competing optimum anywhere in the tested dense range: the good-versus-bad crossover lies far outside it.
